messages:
liz: Folks — quick sync: drafting a lightweight playbook for canary sampling + fallback/auto-rollback after last week's high-blast deploy. Need owners & deadlines.

cheng: thanks. spun up an initial checklist. can we aim for a v0 by EOD Fri?

sam: Prefer Mon so QA can run the 0.1 traces. Also need metric thresholds.

amar: re: thresholds — suggest: error rate > 1.5x baseline for 3 consecutive mins OR p95 latency increase > 30% -> trigger auto-rollback.

maria: agree but let's add user-facing error percentage too. Some infra errors aren't customer-impacting.

liz: good point. include two signal tiers: customer-impacting (5min) and infra-only (10min with human confirm).

deploy-bot: deploy event: canary rollout 2026-03-22T14:02:11Z started by @cheng — 10% sampling.

cheng: we should also add a traffic sampling table and a minimum sample size: don't consider signals unless >= 200 requests/min per instance.

sam: Can we have a small code snippet for the flag gating? e.g.,

```json
{
  "canary_percent": 10,
  "min_rps_for_alerting": 200,
  "rollback_on": ["errors", "latency"]
}
```

amar: also add a step to pause automatic rollback while DB migration in progress. we had false positives last time.

maria: ownership: cheng + sam to write playbook. liz to review. amar to add thresholds to SLO doc.

liz: timeline: draft by Mon (1890076800), review Tue, ship v0 by Thu. Can we lock owners?

cheng: I can take checklist and sampling table.

sam: I'll draft the rollback runbook + alerting rules.

amar: I'll update SLO doc and add a short note in postmortem.

maria: I'll work on the "customer-impacting" signal definitions and test kit for simulations.

liz: @cheng @sam please add PR link to the postmortem thread when ready. Also add a recur pattern note: 'deploys with DB migrations + small canaries' flagged.

cheng: ack — will add PR + a small simulator script to validate detectors.

sam: quick question: auto-rollback cooldown? propose 30m cooldown and max 2 rollbacks per hour.

amar: sounds reasonable.

liz: :thumbsup: I'll create a recurring 2-week check to see if playbook prevented any noisy incidents.

incident-bot: reminder — follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-29 10:00 UTC

maria: Added action items in tasks: https://redwood.inc/tasks/PR-1234 :calendar: 

liz: Thanks team. If no blockers, owners + deadlines stick. we'll close loop in the postmortem follow-ups doc.
